_comment: This repository INSTANTIATES the smart-base harness, as litlfred/smart-trust's seed does (folio-assistant bean rbz3, branch claude/seed-smart-base). The IG source stays where the IG Publisher expects it (input/, sushi-config.yaml); this IG's harness data is under smart-base/: its artefact index, menu and instance declaration (smart-base/smart-immunizations.json), with their history carried from folio-assistant's smart-immunizations/ (bean n3ni, stage E; owner, 2026-10-06). The generated docs/ pages are not copied: they are rebuilt. Mode: the site is built HERE by `.github/workflows/folio-site.yml` (bean b5f0's second mode). Until folio-assistant subscribes to this repository (stage F), that build still reads the instance from the folio-assistant submodule (`folio-assistant/smart-immunizations/`), so the two copies must not diverge; nothing under smart-base/ runs standalone yet, which is the expected state of a seed.
_contentType_comment: `document`. The IG's pages and artefact index are structured prose and data; there is no Lean and no TeX.
